profile.summary: The Public Service Center is a University of California, Berkeley campus center that connects students, faculty and community partners for public service and civic engagement. It runs College Corps at Berkeley, an AmeriCorps program with California Volunteers in which undergraduates serve 450 hours a year with community partners in food justice, climate justice, K-12 education, and behavioral health and wellness.
